notes: The New Duplicator's selection modes, plant mode, fill colour, fill wrench, supercut, fill bricks, force plant, mirroring, cutting, saving, loading and its admin commands as host rules on the native copy seams, with its preference defaults: anyone may use it, full trust to select (admins may select anything, public bricks too), 10,000 bricks a selection for players and 1,000,000 for admins (a big selection, plant, cut, paint, wrench, load or undo goes a slice each tick, as the original's did), its 64-unit box for players and 1024-unit box for admins, a 0.4 s select wait and a 0.4 s plant wait for non-admins, saving, fill wrench, FX paint, force plant and fill bricks for admins only. Its keys come as a binds file listed under "New Duplicator" in Controls: Ctrl C copies, Ctrl V plants, Ctrl X cuts, Ctrl held multiselects, Shift-Ctrl X supercuts, Shift-Ctrl V fills bricks, and every "Send /..." entry can be bound. Stack mode selects up or down, limited or not, and Ctrl adds to the selection; [Light] switches to box mode, turning a selection into a box round it, where a click boxes a brick (with Ctrl, grows the box to the plate clicked), the brick keys move a corner (with Ctrl, the whole box), [Rotate Brick] switches corner (with Ctrl, turns the box) and [Plant Brick] selects what lies in the box. Everyone sees the selection box as the original drew it (see-through faces, gold edges with the selected corner's in blue, shaded corner cubes and "Name's Selection Box" over it; grey edges once it has selected) and gold edges round a selection. A selection glows for a few seconds and stays a selection until a brick key takes it up as a ghost (plant mode); the brick keys move it, a click puts it against what was clicked, [Prev Seat] switches the pivot between the whole selection and its start brick, /PlantAs plants into another brick group (by name or BL_ID, with build trust, or as an admin), and [Plant Brick] plants what fits and says how much was blocked, floating or missing trust; undoing a plant of over 10 bricks asks first. With a selection, a paint or FX can is fill colour ([Plant Brick] paints it, one undo step); /FillWrench opens the wrench on every selected brick; /SuperCut deletes what reaches into the box and puts plain bricks back over what stuck out, and /FillBricks then fills the box in the player's colour, each asked first and each one undo step (the original's supercut had no undo); /ForcePlant and /ToggleForcePlant plant bricks that would float. /MirrorX, /MirrorY and /MirrorZ mirror the ghost and /MirErrors lists the bricks the last mirrored plant had no exact mirror for, /Cut cuts the originals away, /SaveDup and /LoadDup keep and load it by name (asking before overwriting; v20 duplication files dropped in the saves Duplications folder load too), /AllDups lists the saves, /DupVersion and /DupClients name the versions, /ClearDups (admins) puts every duplicator away and /DupHelp lists them all.
